_doc: Stage 8 lane "portrait2". GOAL A: boss portrait style pass, round 2 (painted dark-fantasy, never anime): 15 boss portraits + the purified companion portrait cmp_mt_argen (same character as b_argen). Method = Stage 7: design grid from tools/painted/raw/<boss> (Kling watermark painted out) + style grid of Stage 7 painted portraits; 880x1168 on #00FF00 (or #FF00FF for green subjects: banshee, chimera, moloch, narkissa2, bonedragon, leviathan) -> key with edge-band despill -> centre crop 3:4 -> 768x1024 RGBA WebP q80 m6 alpha_quality 70 -> lo copies by tools/assets/make_variants.py. GOAL B: painted puppets for the 4 companions that had none (mt_argen, mt_morgen, gd_munin, gd_vesper), made by re-colouring the source sheet of the closest painted companion (mt_wyvern, mt_warhorse, gd_owl) so the cut/rig contract is the same; matte without rembg by tools/higgsfield/matte_flat.py.

generations.prompt: Boss bust portrait for a dark-fantasy action game. Paint it in the style of the second reference image (strip of painted boss portraits): hand-painted digital oil painting, textured visible brushwork, muted desaturated colours, soft front-left key light, deep shadows, painterly edges; no line art, no ink outlines, no anime, no cel shading, no comic style. The character is the Banshee exactly as in the first reference image (design sheet): her head is a bare screaming skull — pale grey-white cracked bone, hollow black eye sockets with small glowing teal-cyan pupils, a gaping jaw with long thin fangs — framed by a deep white cloth hood; no hair, no skin, no flesh face. A tattered white burial shroud hangs from the hood over the shoulders, its ragged edges fading into translucent pale cyan strips. A heavy rusted iron chain with faintly glowing teal links is wrapped across her chest. Framing: head, shoulders and upper chest, cut off at mid-chest by the bottom edge; head in the upper third; three-quarter view turned toward the left side of the image. One figure only. no text, no border, no frame, plain flat solid #FF00FF magenta background
generations.note: alternate (banshee_1 has the teal glowing chain links of the design)
